mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate earnings visibility and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 600.0 and RSAFS > 380000.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 for three consecutive months signals expanding manufacturing output and improving supply chain resilience, which reduces earnings volatility and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 131,000 signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate negative returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real private demand (RSAFS) below 375,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, indicates weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which increases corporate cost pressures and reduces earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 94.0 for 2 consecutive months and UNRATE > 9.0
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate negative returns in > 55% of instances.
